seoTitle: Free Docker Compose Generator for Common Services
metaDescription: Pick services such as Postgres, Redis, MongoDB, Nginx or RabbitMQ and get a docker-compose.yml with ports, volumes and env. Free, in your browser.
intro: List the services you need, like postgres, redis and nginx, and get a docker-compose.yml with images, ports, environment variables and named volumes.
why:
Spinning up a local database, cache or message broker is one of the most common reasons to write a Compose file, and the details are easy to forget: which environment variables Postgres needs, where MongoDB keeps its data, which two ports RabbitMQ exposes. Searching documentation each time slows you down.

This tool reads a list of service names and writes a complete services block, with restart policy, port mappings and a named volume for data where one makes sense. It supports postgres, mysql, mariadb, redis, mongo, nginx, rabbitmq, memcached, elasticsearch, minio and mailhog. Passwords are placeholders marked change-me, so replace them before use. The file is meant for development, and it is generated in your browser.
howTo: Type service names, one per line or separated by commas, such as postgres, redis, nginx.
Run the tool to generate the Compose file.
Replace every change-me password and adjust ports or image tags.
Save it as docker-compose.yml and start it with docker compose up.

faq.a: postgres, mysql, mariadb, redis, mongo, nginx, rabbitmq, memcached, elasticsearch, minio and mailhog. An unknown name stops the run and the error lists every supported service.

faq.q: Are the passwords safe to use?
faq.a: No. They are placeholders such as change-me. Replace them, and keep real secrets in an env file or a secrets manager rather than in a file you commit to version control.

faq.q: Does it add a version field or networks?
faq.a: No version key is written, since current Compose ignores it. Services share the default network that Compose creates, so they can reach each other by service name.
The elasticsearch entry runs a single node with security disabled to make local work easy. Never expose that configuration to a public network or use it in production.
